blocks.title: Business solution
blocks.text: Business solutions companies ko masail hal karne aur behtar kaam karne ke tareeqe hain; yeh karobaron ko barhne aur badalne mein bhi madad dete hain.

Agar chhoti grocery dukaan mein aksar maal khatam ho jata hai to zyada baar order dena ya inventory track karne wala software shelves bhari rakhta hai. Agar zyada gahak online khareedte hain to ghar par delivery karobar ko tabdeeli ke saath chalne deti hai.

blocks.prompt: Bakery ke counter par lambi qataaron ka ek business solution bataiye.
blocks.explanation: Pick-up ke liye online ya phone par pehle order, ya masroof waqt mein doosra payment counter. Yeh misal wazahati hai.

items: Business solutions masail hal karte (stock tracking) aur tarraqi dete hain (ghar delivery).
